how_to_check: Run each recompute command from the repo root.

claims.meaning: Business actions in the catalog, one JSON file each.
Actions with status `verified`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `observed`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `gated`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `failed`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `seen`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Actions with status `excluded`. See AGENT.md for what each status means.
Verified actions that change data. Each one passed a read-back in a scenario.
Write actions with at least one passing read-back line in the evidence log.
claims.recompute: jq -s '[.[] | select(.check == "read_back" and .passed) | .checks] | unique | length' evidence/runs.jsonl

claims.meaning: Actions that need the user's OK before they run: deletes, writes that cannot be undone or that change a whole tab or setting, and writes that reach people (those never run).
Calls made by the scripts to the live Bastter web services. Each is one line in the evidence log.
BS2 screens the crawler fetched with the session (the browser capture opened the same screens).
Web service calls the app made while the browser opened the screens.
Scenario files (in scenarios/ and scenarios/archive/) with at least one write proved by a read-back.
Mistakes logged while building the catalog.
Logged mistakes that name the automated check that now catches them.
Errors from the catalog lint. Must be 0.
